topic: Small claims court vs giving up (Kyle vs Ruby)

scenes.narration: Eighty dollars in small claims court wins back five thousand. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench holding up a small claims filing form stamped EIGHTY DOLLARS, comic burst banner reads FIVE THOUSAND BACK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Kyle and Ruby both hire the same handyman to renovate their kitchens.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two adults kyle and ruby standing in matching empty kitchens, smiling at a handyman shaking their hands, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each pays a five thousand dollar deposit and signs the contract.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of kyle and ruby signing matching receipts stamped FIVE THOUSAND DEPOSIT at a kitchen table, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One week later the handyman vanishes with both deposits gone.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an empty unfinished kitchen with tools missing, a shadowy handyman silhouette running offscreen with a bag of cash, comic banner reads VANISHED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Kyle posts angry reviews online and tells everyone the money is gone forever.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man kyle on a couch typing on a laptop with an angry face, comic burst above the laptop reading ONE STAR REVIEW, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He accepts the loss and never files a single legal document.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, kyle shrugging at a kitchen table with a stack of untouched court forms beside him, comic banner reads GAVE UP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ruby files a small claims case for just eighty dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman ruby at a courthouse counter handing eighty dollars and a filing form to a clerk, paper stamped CASE FILED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She brings the contract, payment receipt, and photos of the unfinished kitchen.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, ruby in a courtroom holding a folder labeled CONTRACT and a stack of photos, calmly explaining to a judge, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ninety days later Kyle still has nothing and his reviews disappeared.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked man kyle staring at a laptop showing a deleted business profile, comic banner reads STILL OUT FIVE THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ruby won her judgment and garnished the handyman's bank account.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, ruby holding a court order stamped JUDGMENT, a bank seal stamping a garnishment notice over the handyman's account, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same scam, same loss, but Ruby got every dollar back.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side kyle holding a blank refund line, right side ruby holding a check stamped FIVE THOUSAND RECOVERED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Bring your contract, receipts, and photos. File the case. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel, holding up a small claims filing checklist, comic banner reads FILE THE CASE, kids comic book illustration
